why: Hard reset discards the C3 commit and worktree edits; undo must put them back.
Deletes untracked notes.txt and src/untracked_dir; undo must restore both (not ignored).
Forced checkout drops staged and unstaged edits; undo must restore index and worktree.
Clears the saved-work stash; undo must restore refs/stash and the stash list.
Drops the stash entry; undo must restore it.
Deletes branch other with unmerged O1; undo must restore refs/heads/other.
Moves main back a commit; undo must restore refs/heads/main.
Overwrites origin main; the printed push by the bench must restore the remote ref and local state.
Deletes origin other; the printed push must put the remote branch back.
Removes src including staged and untracked files under it; undo must restore them.
A merge that conflicts on README.md leaves merge state; undo must restore merge state and the conflict stages.
Rebase rewrites branch commits and HEAD; undo must restore refs/heads and HEAD.
Stages every change; undo must restore the index exactly as before.
Removes src from the index only; undo must restore the index entries.
Rewrites the HEAD commit; undo must restore HEAD and refs/heads/main.
Writes a change and discards all unstaged edits; undo must restore the bytes of the earlier state.
Clears the execute bit on bin/run.sh; undo must restore mode bits.
Empties a tracked binary file; undo must restore its bytes.
Deletes annotated tag v1; undo must restore refs/tags/v1.
Deletes the repository metadata; undo must restore the repo state it snapshotted.
Retargets the symlink link; undo must restore the link itself.
Changes only the mtime of README.md, which is a documented non-restored attribute.
Adds an extended attribute, which the undo layer does not restore.
Deletes ignored build output and a file outside the repo, both documented limits.

command: mkdir -p nested && cd nested && git init -q && echo x > a && git add a && git commit -qm n
why: Creates a nested repo, whose contents are a documented limit.
Changes remote-tracking state from a fetch, which the bench does not claim to restore.
